{"subject":"Claim C021207 past payer filing limit, write-off decision needed","body":"Hi billing lead,

Claim C021207 (patient PT0087, service code T1005, 12 units, billed $57.60, date of service 2026-11-03) was submitted on 2027-01-07, 65 days after care. Northwind Health Plan's filing limit is 45 days, and the claim is predicted to deny as D03.

Editing the claim cannot fix this. I need a write-off decision from you on whether to write off the $57.60 or pursue any other route. The visit itself is verified (V004138, 176 minutes), so the issue is timeliness only.

Please let me know your decision as soon as possible, since the claim is already outside the filing window and further delay will not help."}
